newsitem.title: CHINA: Foreign oil lubricants gaining China market share.
newsitem.headline: Foreign oil lubricants gaining China market share.

text.p: Foreign-brand oil lubricants are grabbing a growing share of the Chinese market and are expected to account for 40 percent of sales within two years, the Xinhua news agency said.
Foreign producers' share of the 2.8 million-tonne annual market had soared to 16 percent by the end of 1995 from just 5.6 percent in 1991, the agency said late on Tuesday.
Sales of foreign oil lubricants had grown in response to the increase in the number of cars on China's roads, it quoted an industry newspaper as saying.
Firms from the United States, Britain, Germany and Japan had set up 25 joint ventures in China, producing 450,000 tonnes of lubricants per year, it said.
